PIAE.name: PIN Acquisition Encryption
PIAE.definition: The cardholder enters the PIN, the POI enciphers the PIN Block and provides it as a result to the Sale System.

PIAV.name: PIN Acquisition Verification
PIAV.definition: The Cardholder enters the PIN and the POI verifies it.

PIVO.name: PIN Verify Only
PIVO.definition: The Sale System send a previous keyed PIN and the POI verifies it.
